verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates under ordinary travel reasoning. A offers strong price, proximity, and confirmed basics but its favorable rating lacks a public source and review count. B is a prudent verification-and-fallback approach with a well-supported rating, but is less convenient and more expensive. C is cheapest and closest, though its lower reviewed rating and incomplete explicit confirmation of a queen/mini-fridge create tradeoffs. D has the strongest well-supported rating and confirmed basics, but costs more and is farthest; its pool is an optional extra. With commutes stated as workable and no stated priority among price, verified reputation, proximity, or room configuration, several choices remain defensible.
